ops.title: cc-present: eight UX calls from the board walk (D1-D8), Oct 27 2026
ops.body:
Owner picked on board cc-present-eight-ux-calls-from-the-board-walk--bff35c6f (submitted rev 1, no notes):
D1 focus mode: decision steps first, information-only steps at the end of the deck (first briefly picked 'drop them', then switched).
D2 a card whose every decision is answered shows status 'answered'.
D3 tables show every row; drop the 12-row cap.
D4 one note button per step, on the card.
D5 timeline player controls only when events carry timestamps; otherwise a plain list.
D6 one focus width for the whole deck, set by its widest step.
D7 a reply without --re defaults to the newest unanswered note on its block.
D8 daemon sends the current board snapshot then streams new events; history loads on demand (Earlier rounds).
